symbol.mystcraft.color_cloud.desc: Tints the clouds with the colour written before it (a random colour if none).
symbol.mystcraft.color_fog.desc: Tints the fog with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.color_fog_natural.desc: Fog takes its natural, biome-dependent colour.
symbol.mystcraft.color_foliage.desc: Tints leaves and vines with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.color_foliage_natural.d: Leaves keep their natural, biome-dependent colour.
symbol.mystcraft.color_grass.desc: Tints grass with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.color_grass_natural.des: Grass keeps its natural, biome-dependent colour.
symbol.mystcraft.color_sky.desc: Colours the daytime sky with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.color_sky_natural.desc: The sky keeps its natural blue.
symbol.mystcraft.color_sky_night.desc: Colours the night sky with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.color_water.desc: Tints water with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.no_horizon.desc: Removes the horizon line: the sky continues below the edge of the world.
symbol.mystcraft.rainbow.desc: Hangs a rainbow in the sky. A Direction before it sets where it stands.
symbol.mystcraft.sun_normal.desc: A sun that lights and warms the Age. Direction, Phase and Length symbols written before it set where it travels, where it starts and how long its day is.
symbol.mystcraft.sun_dark.desc: A sun that gives no light: nights without end. Takes the same modifiers as a normal sun.
symbol.mystcraft.moon_normal.desc: A moon that lights the night. Direction, Phase and Length symbols before it set its path, start and cycle.
symbol.mystcraft.moon_dark.desc: A moon that gives no light.
symbol.mystcraft.stars_normal.desc: A plain starfield. A Direction before it sets how it turns.
symbol.mystcraft.stars_end_sky.desc: The shifting starfield of the End fills the sky.
symbol.mystcraft.lighting_normal.desc: Normal sky light: bright days, dark nights.
symbol.mystcraft.lighting_bright.desc: Brighter sky light - even the nights stay fairly light.
symbol.mystcraft.lighting_dark.desc: Dim sky light - even noon is gloomy.
symbol.mystcraft.weather_normal.desc: Rain and storms come and go as in the Overworld.
symbol.mystcraft.biome_native.desc: Biomes are laid out the way the Overworld does it.
symbol.mystcraft.biome_single.desc: The whole Age is one biome: the first Biome symbol written.
symbol.mystcraft.biome_tiled.desc: The written biomes alternate in a repeating tiled pattern.
symbol.mystcraft.biome_grid.desc: The written biomes are arranged in a regular grid.
symbol.mystcraft.terrain_normal.desc: Overworld-style terrain: hills, valleys and seas.
symbol.mystcraft.terrain_flat.desc: A flat world at sea level.
symbol.mystcraft.terrain_nether.desc: Cave-like terrain enclosed in stone, like the Nether.
symbol.mystcraft.terrain_end.desc: Islands floating in a void, like the End.
symbol.mystcraft.terrain_void.desc: No terrain at all - an empty void.
symbol.mystcraft.caves.desc: Cave systems wind through the ground.
symbol.mystcraft.tendrils.desc: Twisting tendrils of stone rise from the ground.
symbol.mystcraft.skylands.desc: Great landmasses float high in the sky.
symbol.mystcraft.floating_islands.desc: Small islands float above the terrain.
symbol.mystcraft.huge_trees.desc: Giant trees grow across the land.
symbol.mystcraft.dense_ores.desc: Ores are far more common - and the Age far less stable.
symbol.mystcraft.villages.desc: Villages are built in the Age.
symbol.mystcraft.vault.desc: A sealed Facility is built near the arrival point. Solve its puzzles to reach the vault and a Linking Book home.
symbol.mystcraft.mineshafts.desc: Abandoned mineshafts run under the Age.
symbol.mystcraft.nether_fortress.desc: Nether fortresses stand in the Age.
symbol.mystcraft.spheres.desc: Hollow spheres of the Block material written before it (random if none) appear in the terrain.
symbol.mystcraft.spikes.desc: Tall spikes of the Block material written before it rise from the surface.
symbol.mystcraft.lakes_surface.desc: Surface lakes of the Block material written before it (water if none).
symbol.mystcraft.lakes_deep.desc: Underground pockets of the Block material written before it.
symbol.mystcraft.obelisks.desc: Obelisks of the Block material written before it.
symbol.mystcraft.crystal_formations.desc: Crystal formations grow from the ground.
symbol.mystcraft.star_fissure.desc: A Star Fissure opens near the arrival point: jump in to return home.
symbol.mystcraft.env_accelerated.desc: Crops, trees and everything that ticks grow and change much faster.
symbol.mystcraft.env_explosions.desc: Explosions go off at random around the Age.
symbol.mystcraft.env_lightning.desc: Lightning strikes often, even in clear weather.
symbol.mystcraft.env_meteors.desc: Meteors fall from the sky and crater the ground.
symbol.mystcraft.env_scorched.desc: Fire breaks out across the surface.
symbol.mystcraft.pvp_off.desc: Players cannot hurt each other in this Age.
symbol.mystcraft.no_sea.desc: No oceans: the land stays dry down to the lowest valleys.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_north.desc: Direction modifier: the next sun, moon or starfield travels towards the north.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_east.desc: Direction modifier: the next sun, moon or starfield travels towards the east.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_south.desc: Direction modifier: the next sun, moon or starfield travels towards the south.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_west.desc: Direction modifier: the next sun, moon or starfield travels towards the west.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_end.desc: Phase modifier: the next celestial starts at its lowest point (midnight).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_rising.desc: Phase modifier: the next celestial starts rising (dawn).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_noon.desc: Phase modifier: the next celestial starts at its highest point (noon).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_setting.desc: Phase modifier: the next celestial starts setting (dusk).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_zero.desc: Length modifier: the next celestial does not move at all.
symbol.mystcraft.creatures_passive.desc: Animals and other passive creatures live here. Takes a spawn rate and a population cap.
symbol.mystcraft.creatures_neutral.desc: Creatures that fight back when provoked live here. Takes a spawn rate and a population cap.
symbol.mystcraft.creatures_hostile.desc: Monsters live here. Takes a spawn rate, a population cap and a difficulty.
symbol.mystcraft.creatures_none.desc: Nothing spawns naturally in this Age. Takes no modifier.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_rate_none.desc: Spawn rate modifier: the group never spawns.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_rate_sparse.desc: Spawn rate modifier: a quarter of the usual spawns.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_rate_dense.desc: Spawn rate modifier: twice the usual spawns.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_rate_swarm.desc: Spawn rate modifier: four times the usual spawns.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_cap_few.desc: Population cap modifier: a quarter of the usual number of creatures.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_cap_many.desc: Population cap modifier: twice the usual number of creatures.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_cap_horde.desc: Population cap modifier: four times the usual number of creatures.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_difficulty_easy.des: Difficulty modifier: hostile creatures have less health and hit softer.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_difficulty_hard.des: Difficulty modifier: hostile creatures have more health and hit harder.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_difficulty_brutal.d: Difficulty modifier: hostile creatures have double health and hit much harder.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_half.desc: Length modifier: the next celestial's cycle lasts half a day.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_full.desc: Length modifier: the next celestial's cycle lasts one day.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_double.desc: Length modifier: the next celestial's cycle lasts two days.
symbol.mystcraft.mod_gradient.desc: Blends the colours written before it into a gradient for the next colour symbol.
symbol.mystcraft.color_horizon.desc: Colours sunrise and sunset with the colour written before it (random if none).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_maroon.desc: Colour modifier: maroon, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_red.desc: Colour modifier: red, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_olive.desc: Colour modifier: olive, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_yellow.desc: Colour modifier: yellow, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_dark_green.de: Colour modifier: dark green, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_green.desc: Colour modifier: green, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_teal.desc: Colour modifier: teal, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_cyan.desc: Colour modifier: cyan, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_navy.desc: Colour modifier: navy, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_blue.desc: Colour modifier: blue, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_purple.desc: Colour modifier: purple, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_magenta.desc: Colour modifier: magenta, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_black.desc: Colour modifier: black, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_grey.desc: Colour modifier: grey, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_silver.desc: Colour modifier: silver, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.mod_color_white.desc: Colour modifier: white, used by the next colour symbol (or blended by Gradient).
symbol.mystcraft.block.wrapper.desc: Material modifier: %s is used by the next feature that needs a block (seas, lakes, spheres, spikes, obelisks).
symbol.mystcraft.biome.wrapper.desc: Adds the %s biome to the Age's biome list.
instability.mystcraft.bonus.death: %s has been killed by %s, activating bonus stability!
instability.mystcraft.bonus.death.partia: %s has died.  Unlocking part of the bonus stability.  Kill them personally to unlock all of it!
instability.mystcraft.bonus.death.alert: %s has entered the age.  Kill them in order to unlock a temporary stability bonus in this age!
instability.mystcraft.bonus.troll.death: %s has been killed, resetting the instability penalty!
instability.mystcraft.bonus.troll.alert: %s has entered the age.  The age will slowly become less stable!  Kill them to reset this!
instability.mystcraft.bonus.troll.left: %s has left the age.  The stability penalty will slowly dissipate.

commands.mystcraft.time.added.all: Added %d to the time in all Ages

gui.mystcraft.binder.missing_link_panel: The first page must be a Link Panel (made in the Ink Mixer).

gui.mystcraft.startup.missing_required: No symbol provides %s; Ages cannot be generated.

advancements.mystcraft.linkbook.descript: Craft a Linking Book. Good, now you can get back!

death.attack.mystcraft.link_disarm: %1$s lost their items to a disarming link
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.slot.ink.desc: Put an ink vial or a bucket of black ink here to fill the basin.
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.slot.paper.desc: Paper is dipped in the basin to make link panels.
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.slot.empty.desc: Empty vials and buckets come out here after their ink is poured in.
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.slot.output.desc: Take the finished link panel page from here. Its effects come from what was mixed into the ink.
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.basin.empty: Pour ink in first (ink vial or bucket into the 'Ink in' slot).
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.basin.hint: Click here while holding an ingredient to mix it into the ink (one item per click). Refilling the ink clears every effect.
gui.mystcraft.book.unknown_symbol: Unknown symbol: %s (its mod is not loaded)
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.basin.clear: Click to add %s: clears every effect
gui.mystcraft.ink_mixer.basin.not_modifi: %s has no effect on the ink.
gui.mystcraft.book_binder.pages.hint: Drag pages here. The first page must be a Link Panel.
gui.mystcraft.book_binder.slot.cover.des: Leather for the cover. A Descriptive Book needs one.
gui.mystcraft.book_binder.slot.output.de: Appears once there is a title, a cover and a link panel as the first page.
gui.mystcraft.link_modifier.slot.book.de: Put a Linking Book or a Descriptive Book here to edit it.
gui.mystcraft.link_modifier.kill.tooltip: Retires this book's Age: players inside are sent home and the Age is recycled.
gui.mystcraft.link_modifier.confirm_kill: Click to permanently mark the Age dead.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.surface.hint: You know no symbols yet. Study a symbol page (use it in your hand) or visit an Age: every symbol you learn appears here, grouped by category. Click a symbol to write a copy into the folder (one paper and some ink).
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.page.write: Click: write a copy into the folder (paper + ink)
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.page.cannot_w: To write copies: add ink, paper and a folder
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.target.hint: Place a Collation Folder in the slot on the left: pages are written into it, and a selected page takes modifiers.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.slot.target.d: A Collation Folder: rename it, write pages into it and attach modifiers to its pages. Bind its pages into a book at the Book Binder.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.slot.paper.de: Each symbol written onto a new page uses one sheet of paper.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.slot.ink.desc: Ink vials or buckets of black ink refill the ink well; empty ones can be filled from it.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.slot.empty.de: Empty vials / buckets are moved here after the ink is poured into the well.
link_property.mystcraft.intra_linking.de: The book can link to a place inside the dimension it is used in.
link_property.mystcraft.intra_linking_on: The book only works inside the dimension it is used in.
link_property.mystcraft.relative.desc: Arrival keeps the traveller's position relative to the departure point.
link_property.mystcraft.disarm.desc: Travellers arrive without their items; they are left behind.
link_property.mystcraft.maintain_momentu: Travellers keep their speed through the link.
link_property.mystcraft.generate_platfor: A small platform is placed under the arrival point.
link_property.mystcraft.following.desc: The book comes with you instead of being left behind at the departure point.
category.mystcraft.terrain.desc: The shape of the land. Required, exactly one. Default: Standard Terrain.
category.mystcraft.biomes.desc: Which biomes the Age is made of (1-4). Required unless the layout is Native, which uses the vanilla overworld set.
category.mystcraft.biome_layout.desc: How the biomes are arranged. Required, exactly one. Default: Native (vanilla-like).
category.mystcraft.lighting.desc: Overall light level. Required, exactly one. Default: Standard Lighting.
category.mystcraft.celestials.desc: Suns, moons, stars and rainbows (1-5). Required; at least one sun. Default: vanilla sun, moon and stars.
category.mystcraft.sky_colors.desc: Sky, night sky, fog, cloud and horizon colours (0-4). Optional: natural colours when absent.
category.mystcraft.world_colors.desc: Foliage, grass and water colours (0-3). Optional: natural colours when absent.
category.mystcraft.weather.desc: How often and what it rains (0-1). Optional: normal weather when absent.
category.mystcraft.structures.desc: Villages, mineshafts, dungeons, strongholds, fortresses, vault (0-3). Optional: none when absent.
category.mystcraft.features.desc: Caves, ravines, lakes, floating islands, obelisks and other terrain features (0-3). Optional: caves and lakes when absent.
category.mystcraft.effects.desc: Environmental effects such as meteors or lightning (0-2). Optional: none when absent.
category.mystcraft.creatures.desc: Which creature groups live in the Age and how many (0-3). Optional: vanilla spawning when absent.
category.mystcraft.materials.desc: Blocks attached to a terrain or feature page to change what it is made of.
category.mystcraft.modifiers.desc: Directions, phases, lengths and colours attached to a page to change how its symbol behaves.
gui.mystcraft.book.summary.dead: This Age has been marked dead.
gui.mystcraft.book.summary.effects.unkno: unknown until the Age is loaded
gui.mystcraft.book.summary.discovered: %s of %s pages discovered at the first link.
item.mystcraft.scholars_writing_desk.des: Offers every symbol there is. Creative only.
item.mystcraft.page.study: Use: study this page to learn its symbols (consumes it)
message.mystcraft.knowledge.known: You already know everything on this page.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.tab.tooltip: Symbols are grouped by category; use the search box to filter by name.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.symbol.attach: Attaches to a page that takes: %s
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.page.select_f: Select a page in the folder strip first, then click this to attach it
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.page.attach: Click: attach to the selected %s page (uses ink)
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.strip.select: Click: select this page (modifiers clicked on the surface attach to it)
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.strip.detach: Shift + right-click: remove the last attached modifier
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.surface.empty: No known symbols in this tab.
gui.mystcraft.writing_desk.strip.erase: Right-click: erase this draft (paper and ink come back)
message.mystcraft.facility.protected: The facility's wards hold until it is solved.
message.mystcraft.facility.lock.accepted: The altar accepts the page. Still missing: %s
message.mystcraft.facility.cache.claimed: You have already claimed this cache.
message.mystcraft.facility.cache.linkboo: A Linking Book home. The facility's wards fall.
commands.mystcraft.facility.unprotected: blocks inside it can be broken
commands.mystcraft.facility.solve.succes: Facility marked solved; its wards are lifted
